$comment: Frozen contract of the .kai extension host as implemented today by desktop/runtime/extension-api-host/host-server.cjs and src/core/extensions/mobile/mobileExtensionHost.ts. Native hosts (Kotlin QuickJS in apps/android-native/core/extensions*, Rust rquickjs in apps/desktop-native/crates/tk-ext) must expose the same bundle methods and answer the same logical routes. Field shapes come from src/core/extensions/sdk/types.ts and abstract-source.ts.

package.bundleFormat: CommonJS (esbuild platform:node format:cjs); module.exports.default || module.exports; if a function it is `new`-ed

properties.name: string
properties.apiServer: { namespace: string, contract: string, routes: string[], healthPath?: string }
properties.capabilities: string[]; known: manga, preview, websiteIndex, theme, metrics-sink, service, module, ui, custom-source
properties.customSources: CustomSourceDescriptor[] { id, kind: read|watch, name, icon?, description? }; non-empty when capabilities has custom-source
properties.contributes: { rendererEntry?, themes?, metrics sinks? }  (renderer entries are NOT supported by native hosts; ignored, never executed)

networkPermission.match: request host === <host> or endsWith('.' + <host>); '*' allows any host (still subject to the SSRF policy of the native fetch)

hostRoutes.note: URL reachability check used by the legacy UI only. NOT part of the native contract.

mount.nativeNote: Native hosts do not open an HTTP port. The same logical routes are in-process calls: ExtensionHost.call(extId, route, params) (Rust) / ExtensionHost.call(extensionId, route, params) (Kotlin). Params are the legacy query-string keys below, as a JSON object; the result is the JSON body the legacy host returned.

NamespaceInfo.customRoutes: string[] (the 5 custom/* routes when customSources is non-empty)

errorStatuses.404: unknown namespace / unknown route / unknown provider
errorStatuses.501: bundle does not implement the method (e.g. a streaming-only bundle asked for manga/*)
errorStatuses.502: bundle threw; body carries error message

routes.transport: SSE by default (stream!=0): events `source` (SourceResultNormalized), `provider_status` (ProviderDiagnostic), `done` {totalCount, cached}, `error` {message}; JSON when stream=0

routes.bundleMethod: torrentAll(opts, onChunk) -> fallback batch(opts) filtered to sourceType torrent
routes.milestone: M2 (native hosts answer but the apps do not play torrents in M0)

response.providers: object[] (each has at least name and kind)

response.chapters: MangaChapterRow[] (one row per chapter x source; `provider` = sub-provider)

sourceOptions.titles | titles[]: string[] (repeatable); merged with titles fetched from AniList by the legacy host, native hosts MAY skip the AniList prefetch because the app passes titles

types.SourceOptions: see src/core/extensions/sdk/types.ts: { anilistId: number, titles: string[], episode?: number, episodeCount?: number, resolution: string, tatakaiId?: string, countryCode?: string, exclusions?: string[], preferredLanguage?: string, preferredLanguages?: string[], providerOptions?: { maxConcurrency?, maxRetries?, retryDelayMs?, timeoutMs? } }
types.SourceResult: { source: string, url: string, quality: string, headers: Record<string,string>, refererCandidates?: string[], subtitles: SubtitleTrack[], audioLanguage?: string, sourceType?: 'torrent'|'hls'|'mp4'|'custom', server?: string }
types.SubtitleTrack: { url: string, label: string, language: string, default?: boolean }
types.SourceResultNormalized: SourceResult plus host-added fields: providerName, providerKey, server, providerPriority, audioLanguage, language, languageLabel, isDub, type, sourceType (hls|mp4|embed|torrent), fileFormat, isM3U8, isEmbed, isTorrent, seeders?, leechers?, peers?, torrentTitle?, fileSize?
types.ProviderDiagnostic: { provider: string, status: 'ok'|'empty'|'error'|'timeout', resultCount: number, durationMs: number, attempts: number, error?: string }
types.LanguageCapability: { language: string, label: string, type: 'audio'|'subtitle', sourceHint?: string }
types.CustomFilterSchema: { tags?: string[], groups?: { key, label, options: { value, label }[] }[] }
types.CustomInfoResult: { id, title, image?, description?, meta?: Record<string,string>, entries: { id, label, number? }[] }
types.CustomReadPageImage: { pageNumber: number, imageUrl: string, headers?: Record<string,string> }

abstractSource.$comment: src/core/extensions/sdk/abstract-source.ts. The aggregate methods above (sourcesAll/streamAll/torrentAll/...) are what the real Toko/Aurora bundles expose; AbstractSource is the minimal fallback shape.
abstractSource.hostFallback: route stream without streamAll -> single(opts); sources/torrent without *All -> batch(opts) (torrent filtered by sourceType 'torrent')

nativeMapping.$comment: How the native apps turn a normalized source into core:model StreamSource / tk-core StreamSource. Only hls and mp4 are playable in M0.

StreamSource.headers: SourceResult.headers (all, attached to the player's HTTP requests; no local proxy exists natively). Try refererCandidates[] in order if the first Referer 403s
StreamSource.subtitles: SourceResult.subtitles -> SubtitleTrack{ url, lang=language, label, format inferred from extension: vtt|srt|ass }

skipped.embed: type embed / custom: not playable natively in M0, listed as unsupported in the UI

nativeMapping.ordering: providerPriority ascending, then quality descending, then preferredLanguages order
